title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire and partners Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, Ethiopia works towards the goal that poor and marginalised people have sustainable livelihoods and diverse food. This objective focuses on engaging communities to protect and enhance biodiversity/natural resources and the environment. Activities include training and accompanyment and provide inputs/cash for work to women and men on rehabilitation of water schemes development, watershed management, and rangeland management. The principal focus of this outcome is: - Management of natural resources to protect local biodiversity - Community-led natural resource governance and disaster risk management processes to protect and strengthen communities’ abilities to face crisis and also to protect what they have - Natural resource management in fragile contexts is part of the nexus approach which is important for building resilience. Natural resource management is directly linked to climate adaptation as many of the impacts of climate are closely connected to changes in natural ecosystems e.g. land, water, soil, air.
Capacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
